required_context: Section A.1 designation of Outfall 001 as Intermittent Flow

notes: The Flow row couples report-only limitation entries with discharge-conditioned monitoring on an intermittent outfall; resolving whether (*1) scopes only monitoring or also limit/reporting applicability changes limit pairing, monitoring obligation, and missing-evidence classification across non-discharge periods.
